title: Advanced 3D Periodic Table with Scoring System
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js that implements an advanced 3D periodic table quiz with a scoring system and an animated parrot mascot.

## Scene Setup
- Use Three.js with OrbitControls and GLTFLoader from CDN.
- Set up a perspective camera at position (0, 5, 20), looking at origin.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.6) and a directional light at (5, 10, 7) with intensity 0.8.
- Background color: #1a1a2e (dark navy).

## 3D Periodic Table Grid
- Create a simplified 3D periodic table showing the first 18 elements (H through Ar) arranged in a grid.
- Each element is a 3D box (1.2 x 1.2 x 0.3) with rounded-feel edges, spaced 1.5 units apart.
- Row 1: H (col 0), He (col 17). Row 2: Li, Be, B, C, N, O, F, Ne (cols 0-1, then 12-17). Row 3: Na, Mg, Al, Si, P, S, Cl, Ar (cols 0-1, then 12-17).
- Each box has a text sprite or canvas texture showing the element symbol and atomic number.
- Color-code by category: alkali metals (#ff6b6b), alkaline earth (#ffd93d), nonmetals (#6bcb77), noble gases (#4d96ff), metalloids (#ff922b), halogens (#cc5de8), other (#adb5bd).
- Store element data: symbol, name, atomicNumber, category, atomicMass for each element.

## Parrot Mascot
- Load 'Parrot.glb' using GLTFLoader. Place it at position (8, 3, 0) with scale (0.02, 0.02, 0.02).
- If the model has animations, play the first animation in a loop using THREE.AnimationMixer.
- The parrot acts as a quiz mascot. When the user answers correctly, make the parrot do a small bounce (translate Y up 1 unit and back over 0.5s). When wrong, make it shake side to side.

## Quiz System
- Implement a quiz mode with 3 question types that cycle: (1) 'What is the atomic number of [Element]?', (2) 'Which element has the symbol [Symbol]?', (3) 'What category does [Element] belong to?'
- Generate random questions from the 18 elements.
- Display the current question in a DOM overlay div at the top center (id='question-display').
- For type 1: user must click the correct element box in 3D. For type 2: user must click the correct element box. For type 3: provide 4 DOM buttons (id='option-0' through 'option-3') below the question.
- Highlight hovered elements with emissive glow.
- On correct answer: flash the element green, increment score, parrot bounces, show 'Correct!' text (id='feedback-text').
- On wrong answer: flash the element red, decrement lives, parrot shakes, show 'Wrong!' text.

## Scoring & Lives System
- Start with score=0, lives=3, questionsAnswered=0, streak=0.
- Correct answer: score += 10 * (1 + streak * 0.5), streak += 1. Wrong answer: streak = 0, lives -= 1.
- Display score (id='score-display'), lives (id='lives-display'), streak (id='streak-display'), and questions answered (id='questions-answered') in a HUD panel at top-right.
- When lives reach 0, show a 'Game Over' overlay (id='game-over-overlay', display changes from 'none' to 'flex') with final score.

## Controls
- A 'Start Quiz' button (id='start-btn') begins the quiz. Before starting, elements are just explorable.
- A 'Reset' button (id='reset-btn') resets score, lives, streak, and starts fresh.
- Keyboard 'H' toggles a help panel (id='help-panel') with instructions.
- Clicking an element in explore mode (before quiz starts) shows its info in a panel (id='element-info-panel') with name, symbol, atomic number, mass, category.

## State Management
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
  - score (number)
  - lives (number)
  - streak (number)
  - questionsAnswered (number)
  - quizActive (boolean)
  - gameOver (boolean)
  - currentQuestionType (number: 1, 2, or 3)
  - currentQuestionElement (string: element symbol)
  - selectedElement (string or null: last clicked element symbol)
  - parrotLoaded (boolean)
  - parrotBouncing (boolean)
  - parrotShaking (boolean)
  - helpVisible (boolean)
  - elementsCount (number: total element boxes created)
  - lastAnswerCorrect (boolean or null)
  - elementInfoVisible (boolean)

## Animation
- Use requestAnimationFrame loop. Update AnimationMixer for parrot. Animate any ongoing effects (glow pulses, bounces).
physics_constraints: Parrot bounce animation should follow smooth easing (up 1 unit and back in 0.5s). Element highlight should use emissive property changes. Score calculation must follow: base 10 points * (1 + streak * 0.5) multiplier.
